description: GeoIP lookup from host.ip into host.geo (ECS). Copies OTel resource host.ip first.

script.description: Copy resource.attributes host.ip onto ECS host.ip when missing
script.source: if (ctx.host == null) { ctx.host = new HashMap(); } if (ctx.host.ip != null) { return; } if (ctx.resource == null || ctx.resource.attributes == null) { return; } def ip = ctx.resource.attributes['host.ip']; if (ip != null) { ctx.host.ip = ip; }

script.description: Expose lat,lon as a resource attribute so TSDS metrics can plot GeoIP
script.source: if (ctx.resource == null) { ctx.resource = new HashMap(); } if (ctx.resource.attributes == null) { ctx.resource.attributes = new HashMap(); } def loc = ctx.host.geo.location; ctx.resource.attributes['geo.location'] = 'POINT(' + loc.lon + ' ' + loc.lat + ')'; if (ctx.host.geo.country_iso_code != null) { ctx.resource.attributes['geo.country_iso_code'] = ctx.host.geo.country_iso_code; }

_meta.description: SRE-01 host.ip GeoIP enrichment for logs@default-pipeline and OTel @custom streams
